// app.jsx — torrnet main application. Composes everything + tweaks.
(function () {
  const { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } = React;
  const {
    TORRENTS, stepTorrent, fmtSpeed,
    TorrentTable, NavItems, Brand, DetailPanel, AddModal, StatusBar, Toolbar,
    useTweaks, TweaksPanel, TweakSection, TweakRadio, TweakToggle, TweakColor,
    Icon,
  } = window;

  const TWEAK_DEFAULTS = /*EDITMODE-BEGIN*/{
    "layout": "sidebar",
    "dark": false,
    "accent": "#E76A2E",
    "density": "comfortable",
    "progress": "bar"
  }/*EDITMODE-END*/;

  const ACCENTS = ["#E76A2E", "#00ADD8", "#7A5AE0", "#1f9e8f"];
  const MAXH = 40; // chart history points

  function App() {
    const [t, setTweak] = useTweaks(TWEAK_DEFAULTS);
    const [torrents, setTorrents] = useState(() => TORRENTS.map((x) => ({ ...x })));
    const [selId, setSelId] = useState("t1");
    const [filter, setFilter] = useState("all");
    const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
    const [addOpen, setAddOpen] = useState(false);
    const [globalHist, setGlobalHist] = useState([]);
    const histRef = useRef({}); // per-torrent history

    // live simulation tick
    useEffect(() => {
      const iv = setInterval(() => {
        setTorrents((prev) => prev.map((tr) => {
          const upd = stepTorrent(tr);
          const next = { ...tr, ...upd };
          const h = histRef.current[tr.id] || [];
          h.push({ d: next.down || 0, u: next.up || 0 });
          if (h.length > MAXH) h.shift();
          histRef.current[tr.id] = h;
          return next;
        }));
      }, 1000);
      return () => clearInterval(iv);
    }, []);

    // global history derived each tick
    useEffect(() => {
      const totD = torrents.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.down || 0), 0);
      const totU = torrents.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.up || 0), 0);
      setGlobalHist((h) => {
        const n = [...h, { d: totD, u: totU }];
        return n.length > MAXH ? n.slice(-MAXH) : n;
      });
    }, [torrents]);

    // apply theme + accent to :root
    useEffect(() => {
      const r = document.documentElement;
      r.dataset.theme = t.dark ? "dark" : "light";
      r.style.setProperty("--accent", t.accent);
    }, [t.dark, t.accent]);

    function action(id, kind) {
      if (kind === "remove") {
        setTorrents((p) => p.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
        if (selId === id) setSelId(null);
        return;
      }
      setTorrents((p) => p.map((x) => {
        if (x.id !== id) return x;
        if (kind === "pause") return { ...x, status: "paused", down: 0, up: 0 };
        if (kind === "resume") return { ...x, status: x.progress >= 1 ? "seeding" : "downloading" };
        return x;
      }));
    }
    const pauseAll = () => setTorrents((p) => p.map((x) => x.status === "downloading" || x.status === "seeding" || x.status === "queued" ? { ...x, status: "paused", down: 0, up: 0 } : x));
    const resumeAll = () => setTorrents((p) => p.map((x) => x.status === "paused" ? { ...x, status: x.progress >= 1 ? "seeding" : "downloading" } : x));

    function addTorrent({ mode, fileName }) {
      const name = mode === "file" ? fileName.replace(/\.torrent$/i, "") : "Magnet torrent — đang lấy metadata...";
      const id = "t" + Date.now();
      const nt = {
        id, name, category: "software", size: (1 + Math.random() * 6) * 1024 ** 3,
        progress: 0, status: "downloading", down: 0, up: 0, peers: 3, seeds: 5, ratio: 0,
        added: "vừa xong", hash: Array.from({ length: 40 }, () => "0123456789abcdef"[Math.floor(Math.random() * 16)]).join(""),
        files: [{ path: name + "/data.bin", size: (1 + Math.random() * 6) * 1024 ** 3, prog: 0, prio: "normal" }],
      };
      setTorrents((p) => [nt, ...p]);
      setSelId(id);
    }

    // filtering
    const visible = useMemo(() => torrents.filter((tr) => {
      if (filter === "downloading" && tr.status !== "downloading") return false;
      if (filter === "seeding" && tr.status !== "seeding") return false;
      if (filter === "completed" && !(tr.status === "completed" || tr.status === "seeding")) return false;
      if (filter === "paused" && tr.status !== "paused") return false;
      if (query && !tr.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())) return false;
      return true;
    }), [torrents, filter, query]);

    const counts = useMemo(() => ({
      all: torrents.length,
      downloading: torrents.filter((x) => x.status === "downloading").length,
      seeding: torrents.filter((x) => x.status === "seeding").length,
      completed: torrents.filter((x) => x.status === "completed" || x.status === "seeding").length,
      paused: torrents.filter((x) => x.status === "paused").length,
    }), [torrents]);

    const totalDown = torrents.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.down || 0), 0);
    const totalUp = torrents.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.up || 0), 0);
    const activeN = torrents.filter((x) => x.status === "downloading" || x.status === "seeding").length;
    const connections = torrents.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.peers || 0), 0);

    const selected = torrents.find((x) => x.id === selId) || null;
    const selHist = (selId && histRef.current[selId]) || [];

    const isTop = t.layout === "topbar";

    return (
      <div className={"app " + (isTop ? "lay-top" : "lay-side")}>
        {/* Navigation */}
        {isTop ? (
          <header className="topbar">
            <Brand />
            <NavItems active={filter} onNav={setFilter} counts={counts} vertical={false} />
            <div className="top-mini mono"><span className="dl">↓ {fmtSpeed(totalDown)}</span><span className="ul">↑ {fmtSpeed(totalUp)}</span></div>
          </header>
        ) : (
          <aside className="sidebar">
            <Brand />
            <NavItems active={filter} onNav={setFilter} counts={counts} vertical={true} />
            <div className="side-foot">
              <div className="mini-speed"><span className="dl"><Icon name="download" size={13} /> {fmtSpeed(totalDown)}</span><span className="ul"><Icon name="upload" size={13} /> {fmtSpeed(totalUp)}</span></div>
            </div>
          </aside>
        )}

        {/* Main column */}
        <div className="main">
          <Toolbar query={query} onQuery={setQuery} onAdd={() => setAddOpen(true)} onPauseAll={pauseAll} onResumeAll={resumeAll} />
          <div className="content">
            <div className="list-wrap">
              {visible.length ? (
                <TorrentTable torrents={visible} selectedId={selId} onSelect={setSelId} onAction={action} density={t.density} progressStyle={t.progress} />
              ) : (
                <div className="empty"><Icon name="search" size={28} /><p>Không có torrent nào khớp.</p></div>
              )}
            </div>
            {selected && <DetailPanel torrent={selected} history={selHist} accent={t.accent} onClose={() => setSelId(null)} />}
          </div>
          <StatusBar totalDown={totalDown} totalUp={totalUp} active={activeN} connections={connections} dht={"3,841"} />
        </div>

        <AddModal open={addOpen} onClose={() => setAddOpen(false)} onAdd={addTorrent} />

        <TweaksPanel>
          <TweakSection label="Bố cục" />
          <TweakRadio label="Layout" value={t.layout} options={["sidebar", "topbar"]} onChange={(v) => setTweak("layout", v)} />
          <TweakRadio label="Mật độ" value={t.density} options={["compact", "comfortable"]} onChange={(v) => setTweak("density", v)} />
          <TweakRadio label="Kiểu tiến trình" value={t.progress} options={["bar", "ring", "striped"]} onChange={(v) => setTweak("progress", v)} />
          <TweakSection label="Giao diện" />
          <TweakToggle label="Chế độ tối" value={t.dark} onChange={(v) => setTweak("dark", v)} />
          <TweakColor label="Màu nhấn" value={t.accent} options={ACCENTS} onChange={(v) => setTweak("accent", v)} />
        </TweaksPanel>
      </div>
    );
  }

  ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root")).render(<App />);
})();
